name: Celebration & Event Microsite Page Blueprints
instructions: Choose only the pages the event needs. Adapt the information architecture to the couple, celebration, guest journey, privacy model and event lifecycle. Never include every optional block automatically.

blueprints.purpose: Introduce the couple or hosts, communicate the event and route guests to the next important action without placing the whole story on the homepage.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Media-led hero with concise event identity and one primary action; following sections should alternate information, people and media rather than repeat identical cards.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Keep names, date, location and primary action in the first view; use deliberate stacking, focal-point-aware images and a compact event menu.
antiPatterns: countdown as the only useful information
more than two equal hero actions
acceptanceCriteria: A guest understands who, what, when, where and what to do next within the first viewport.
The page changes correctly before, during and after the event.
Long content is routed to dedicated pages or progressive disclosure.

blueprints.purpose: Introduce each partner or host with an emotionally specific but scannable profile.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Balanced individual profile compositions with distinct portraits and facts; avoid forcing both people into identical cards when their stories differ.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Lead with a short summary and facts, then disclose full biographies on request. Maintain readable line length and clear partner separation.
antiPatterns: generated portraits presented as the couple
acceptanceCriteria: Each person feels distinct and accurately represented.
The first profile screen is scannable on mobile.
All personal claims are verified or marked for confirmation.

blueprints.purpose: Tell the relationship or celebration story through meaningful milestones rather than an undifferentiated essay.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Use a clear temporal spine, alternating media only when it aids reading and short chapter summaries before full narrative.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Convert to a single-column ordered journey with summaries, expandable detail and predictable scroll position.
acceptanceCriteria: The sequence is understandable without animation.
Guests can scan the story before reading details.
Every milestone has verified content and optional media provenance.

blueprints.purpose: Help guests understand the schedule, venues, arrival expectations and practical instructions for one or more linked events.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Present multiple events in chronological order with distinct venue and action information; keep maps secondary to written addresses.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use stacked itinerary items, sticky or repeated directions actions and tap-safe calendar/map links.
antiPatterns: all events given equal weight when attendance differs
acceptanceCriteria: Each event has an explicit date, time, timezone and location.
Guests can distinguish which events they are invited to.
Directions and calendar actions have accessible labels and fallbacks.

blueprints.purpose: Communicate attire expectations and event colours clearly without relying on colour alone.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Pair concise guidance with labelled swatches and selective examples; preserve whitespace and avoid a catalogue-like wall of inspiration images.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Stack labelled swatches and short guidance; ensure colour names and contrast remain readable.
acceptanceCriteria: A guest can understand the dress code without viewing images.
Every swatch has a name and accessible contrast.
Examples are owned, licensed or clearly identified as conceptual.

blueprints.purpose: Present photographs and videos as a coherent, accessible memory collection.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Use a deliberate image rhythm with varied crops only when focal points are protected; viewer opens in an accessible dialog.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use swipe-safe media, visible position, captions outside image overlays and a close control that remains reachable.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer is keyboard operable and restores focus.
Images are responsive, appropriately compressed and consented.
The gallery remains usable with motion reduced or JavaScript delayed.

blueprints.purpose: Confirm invited guests, collect only necessary attendance information and provide a reliable confirmation or recovery path.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Use a focused form with progressive steps only when necessary; keep event and guest context visible.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use single-column fields, native-friendly controls, persistent progress only when multi-step and no keyboard-obscured submit action.
acceptanceCriteria: The data source and confirmation mechanism are explicitly classified.
Guest lookup cannot expose unrelated guests.
Every error explains impact and recovery.
Closed RSVP has a clear contact path when appropriate.

blueprints.purpose: Explain optional gifting respectfully while protecting financial and delivery details.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Separate registry, transfer and physical-gift options; disclose sensitive details only after deliberate action or guest verification.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use clear stacked choices, safe copy controls and persistent verification messaging.
antiPatterns: bank details in indexed page text
acceptanceCriteria: Financial details are host-confirmed and protected according to the privacy model.
Gifting remains optional in language and hierarchy.
Every external registry link identifies its destination.

blueprints.purpose: Help travelling guests plan transport, accommodation and local arrival without creating unsupported booking promises.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Group information by journey stage and distinguish recommendations from official arrangements.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use short travel cards or accordions with copyable addresses and tap-safe contact links.
acceptanceCriteria: Official arrangements and recommendations are clearly distinguished.
Every date-sensitive detail has an owner and confirmation status.
Contact and address information is usable offline or in low connectivity.

blueprints.purpose: Resolve common guest questions without repeating operational information across every page.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Use a readable accordion or grouped list with direct answers and links to source pages.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Maintain large disclosure targets, stable focus and no nested accordions.
antiPatterns: answers dependent on colour or icons
acceptanceCriteria: Answers agree with the event contract.
Accordion is keyboard operable and exposes expanded state.
Guests have a fallback contact path.

blueprints.purpose: Transition the site from invitation mode to gratitude, memories and controlled archival after the celebration.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Replace countdown and RSVP prominence with gratitude and memories; retain practical archival links only when useful.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Lead with thank-you content and a lightweight gallery; avoid forcing guests through old pre-event sections.
antiPatterns: automatic publication of private guest media
acceptanceCriteria: The pre-event primary action is removed or replaced.
Media publishing follows consent and privacy settings.
The archive or retention plan is visible to hosts and implemented.
